name: Soukan Yuugi
source:
A board game sample gotten from a toy company's salesman who said will help "get along with the people you play with".
However, this game is no ordinary game.
The protagonist decides to play it with his mother and little sister, but without noticing, the moment you start playing the game, you became unable to leave the room or ask for help.
They will have to keep rolling the dice to reach the end in what became a closed room.
Then, depending on the square they land on, they will be forced to take erotic actions...

[Roughly translated from the [url=http://www.blackrainbow.jp/br/soukan/index.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
主角從玩具公司推銷員那裡得到了一款桌上遊戲，對方聲稱這款遊戲有助於「增進與同玩者的關係」。然而，這並不是普通的遊戲。

主角決定和母親、妹妹一起遊玩，卻沒注意到：遊戲一旦開始，所有人就無法離開房間，也無法呼救。

他們必須在封閉的房間裡不斷擲骰子，直到抵達終點；而根據停下來的格子，他們還會被迫做出各種色情行為……

[意譯自[url=http://www.blackrainbow.jp/br/soukan/index.html]官方網站[/url]]
